## Skill checklist (delete if not adding/updating a skill)

- [ ] Folder name matches the `name` field in frontmatter (lowercase-with-hyphens)

- [ ] License, compatibility, and permission metadata are accurate
- [ ] SKILL.md body is under 500 lines; long details live in `references/`
- [ ] I tested the skill against real prompts (listed below)
- [ ] Benchmark suite has 5+ trigger prompts, 5+ near misses, and 3+ graded tasks
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes locally
- [ ] Any `scripts/` are plainly written, with no undisclosed network calls
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see CONTRIBUTING.md
